name: customers-by-last-name
description: GET /customers?lastName=a runs the DSQL query with lastName like 'a%' ORDER BY lastName ASC and renders each returned record as lastNamefirstNameemail inside the customer/index.html template, in the order NetSuite returned them.

source.reference: get-customer-list-from-netsuite/src/main/app/get-customer-list-from-netsuite.xml (flow get-customer-list-from-netsuiteFlow: expression-filter, netsuite:query, dw:transform-message, parse-template customer/index.html); src/main/resources/customer/index.html; records from src/test/resources/sample_data/list_Customer.dwl; request from src/test/java/org/mule/examples/GetCustomersListFromNetsuiteIT.java

body.q: SELECT email,firstName,lastName FROM CUSTOMER WHERE lastName like 'a%' ORDER BY lastName ASC
